title: Ture
summary: Ture alternates heavy attacks with a clearly announced area rampage.
overview: Ture alternates ordinary combat with a short area-rampage window. Move the melee group out on the warning, keep the main tank covered, then return when the rampage ends.

phases.label: Combat
phases.description: Maintain boss damage and heal through breath and destruction casts.

phases.label: Rampage warning
phases.description: Move vulnerable melee players out of the area.

phases.label: Area rampage
phases.description: Keep healing on the tank and wait for the rampage to end before moving back in.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Melee should move out when the rampage warning begins.
The warning gives six seconds before a ten-second area-rampage window. Return after it ends.
Keep the tank covered through recurring breath and destruction casts.
